author: Isabella Mallaby
content: We hired a small soft play package and ball pond for a christening party. Great & courteous communication from the outset. On the day itself delivery and pick up was punctual and efficient (one less thing to worry about!). The soft play itself went down a storm - we had children playing aged from 9 months to 11 years old - and was clean and in good condition. I'll definitely be hiring from these guys again.
